Text: The opening introduces the state of Rosetta's new frame and the Commandant's task to help activate it, with Mina's appearance setting up a mystery.\n
Investigate in the Military Security Area
Rosetta fell into a coma after confronting enemies that emerged in the Arctic regions. Somewhere within Babylonia, there should be a way to help her recover.
To awaken Rosetta, you must dive into the M.I.N.D., unlock the black box within the "Malkuth" frame, and defeat the enemies guarding it.

The "Mina" who appeared in Babylonia was not the real one. After the attempted attack failed, he took advantage of the chaos to slip away, and Rosetta, who had just regained consciousness, immediately went after him.
After the chase, everyone comes to the rooftop of the Military Security Area.
The declaration of the "Frostheart Emperor" signals the beginning of a new wave of crisis and turmoil. Per Asimov's instructions, go find him first and talk through what to do next.
